model.note: The model that ran this session matches the roster model for coder 2 (Claude Opus 4.8).

effort_setting: not exposed to the session by the system; the harness reported no reasoning-effort value (permission_mode: auto)
tools_used: Bash with python3 -I (to read and lay out rules.json and spot-check rule texts and family codes; no decisions were scripted)
git via Bash (commit and push to orch/sb-c2)
method_note: Every entry of all 11 families and the rules of each entry were read in full. Each entry was compared against every entry of the other families (no sampling). For each candidate the merged-obligation sentence and the merge test (one obligation, legitimate cases preserved, same kind with the candidate-pattern/boundary-register exception and the proxy-group same-measure rule) were applied by hand; pair decisions, merged invariants and reasons were written by the model, not generated by a script.
